name: In-place Sparse NanoVDB SDF Reading
definition: A technique to read sparse NanoVDB signed distance fields (SDFs) in their stored sparse form without densifying them into a full voxel grid, allowing memory usage to follow the surface geometry rather than bounding box volume.
summary: In-place Sparse NanoVDB SDF Reading reads sparse signed distance fields without densifying them, scaling memory to geometry and enabling continuous gradients via configurable interpolation.
